summary: Repair two stale installer regression assertions that stop the forge's installer job.

guide.reason: Only regression expectations change to match the existing log reader signature and text-wizard wording; installer behavior and operator steps are unchanged.

api.reason: The harness calls a local installer C function and does not affect any Controller, Core or client API.

roadmap.reason: The CI harness fix does not change a milestone's capability or acceptance status.

state.reason: The regression harness persists no product state.

verification.method: Forge installer job 5582 on run 4412 failed to compile the generated C; python3 tests/integration/installer-shell.py reproduced that failure locally before correction and passed afterward. The next installer-text-wizard.py scenario failed locally at erase_summary before its expectation was corrected, then passed all sh scenarios. Installer source checks and other available regressions were run locally; the GTK2 disk check and ash scenarios could not run because those dependencies are absent locally. No forge rerun has occurred.
